Triggers internal fault debounce algorithms (counter-based or timer-based) before transitioning qualification states. function Dem_ResetEventStatus [SWS_CP_DIAG_00002] Std_ReturnType Dem_ResetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId); Resets the fault debounce counter and event qualification status for the specified diagnostic event. function Dem_GetEventStatus [SWS_CP_DIAG_00003] Std_ReturnType Dem_GetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId, Dem_UdsStatusByteType* EventStatusByte); Reads the current UDS status byte (ISO 14229-1: testFailed, testFailedThisOperationCycle, pendingDTC, confirmedDTC, testNotCompletedSinceLastClear, testFailedSinceLastClear, testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle, warningIndicatorRequested) for the event. function Dem_GetEventFailed [SWS_CP_DIAG_00004] Std_ReturnType Dem_GetEventFailed(Dem_EventIdType EventId, boolean* EventFailed); Returns TRUE if the diagnostic event is currently qualified as failed. function Dem_SetEventAvailable [SWS_CP_DIAG_00005] Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventAvailable(Dem_EventIdType EventId, boolean AvailableStatus); Enables or suppresses the availability of a diagnostic event depending on variant coding and hardware configuration. Diagnostic Communication Manager (DCM) The DCM implements unified diagnostic services according to ISO 14229-1 (UDS) and ISO 15765-4 (OBD). It manages diagnostic sessions, security levels, and service routing. function Dcm_GetActiveProtocol [SWS_CP_DIAG_00010] Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetActiveProtocol(Dcm_ProtocolType* ActiveProtocol); Returns the currently active diagnostic protocol (e.g. UDS_ON_CAN, UDS_ON_IP, OBD). function Dcm_ResetToDefaultSession [SWS_CP_DIAG_00011] Std_ReturnType Dcm_ResetToDefaultSession(void); Resets the diagnostic session to DEFAULT_SESSION (0x01) upon S3Server timer expiration or protocol termination. function Dcm_GetSesCtrlType [SWS_CP_DIAG_00012] Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetSesCtrlType(Dcm_SesCtrlType* SesCtrlType); Provides the active session type (Default, Programming, Extended Diagnostic, or Safety System Session). function Dcm_GetSecurityLevel [SWS_CP_DIAG_00013] Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetSecurityLevel(Dcm_SecLevelType* SecLevel); Provides the current security access level granted via SecurityAccess (0x27) seed & key exchange. versions.content: AUTOSAR Classic Operating System (OS) The AUTOSAR OS provides fixed-priority preemptive scheduling based on OSEK/VDX OS, support for multi-core synchronization, schedule tables, events, alarms, and resource management with priority ceiling protocol. function ActivateTask [SWS_CP_OS_00001] StatusType ActivateTask(TaskType TaskID); Activate a task. Transitions a task from the SUSPENDED state into the READY state. If the activated task has a higher priority than the currently running task, a preemption occurs. function TerminateTask [SWS_CP_OS_00002] StatusType TerminateTask(void); Terminates the calling task and returns its state to SUSPENDED. Forces a rescheduling step to dispatch the highest priority ready task. function ChainTask [SWS_CP_OS_00003] StatusType ChainTask(TaskType TaskID); Terminates the calling task and immediately activates the chained successor task without intermediate rescheduling of lower-priority tasks. function Schedule [SWS_CP_OS_00004] StatusType Schedule(void); Explicit preemption point allowing non-preemptive tasks to yield execution if higher-priority tasks have become ready. function GetTaskState [SWS_CP_OS_00005] StatusType GetTaskState(TaskType TaskID, TaskStateRefType State); Returns the current execution state (RUNNING, WAITING, READY, SUSPENDED) of the queried task. Event and Synchronization Mechanisms Extended tasks can block and synchronize on event masks (ECC1 and ECC2 conformance classes). function SetEvent [SWS_CP_OS_00006] StatusType SetEvent(TaskType TaskID, EventMaskType Mask); Sets the event bits for the specified extended task. If the task was waiting for any of these events, it transitions from WAITING to READY. function WaitEvent [SWS_CP_OS_00007] StatusType WaitEvent(EventMaskType Mask); Causes the calling extended task to transition to WAITING until at least one of the specified events in Mask is set. function ClearEvent [SWS_CP_OS_00008] StatusType ClearEvent(EventMaskType Mask); Clears the specified event bits from the event mask of the calling extended task. Alarms and Resource Management Alarms trigger cyclic activations and notifications. Priority ceiling protocol on resources prevents unbounded priority inversion. function SetRelAlarm [SWS_CP_OS_00009] StatusType SetRelAlarm(AlarmType AlarmID, TickType increment, TickType cycle); Arms an alarm relative to the current counter value. Can be one-shot (cycle = 0) or cyclic (cycle > 0). function GetResource [SWS_CP_OS_00011] StatusType GetResource(ResourceType ResID); Locks a shared resource and raises the priority of the calling task to the ceiling priority of the resource. function ReleaseResource [SWS_CP_OS_00012] StatusType ReleaseResource(ResourceType ResID); Unlocks a shared resource and restores the task priority to its previous level.

versions.content: ECU State Manager (EcuM) The EcuM manages the state machine of the ECU lifecycle, including off-state, startup phases, run state, sleep modes, and shutdown sequences. function EcuM_Init [SWS_CP_SYS_00002] void EcuM_Init(void); Initializes the ECU State Manager during STARTUP Phase I before the OS is started. Sets up low-level drivers and prepares memory hardware. function EcuM_StartupTwo [SWS_CP_SYS_00003] void EcuM_StartupTwo(void); Carries out STARTUP Phase II activities after the OS has been started and the first BSW tasks are active. Starts the BswM and initializes higher-layer services. function EcuM_RequestRUN [SWS_CP_SYS_00006] Std_ReturnType EcuM_RequestRUN(EcuM_UserType user); Places a RUN state request on behalf of a SW-C or system component to prevent the ECU from transitioning into sleep or shutdown. function EcuM_ReleaseRUN [SWS_CP_SYS_00007] Std_ReturnType EcuM_ReleaseRUN(EcuM_UserType user); Releases a previously requested RUN state. When all RUN requests are released, EcuM permits transition to POST_RUN and shutdown. function EcuM_GoDown [SWS_CP_SYS_00004] Std_ReturnType EcuM_GoDown(uint16 callerHash); Instructs the EcuM to prepare shutdown and invoke shutdown hooks across all BSW modules. function EcuM_GoHalt [SWS_CP_SYS_00005] Std_ReturnType EcuM_GoHalt(void); Places the microcontroller into low-power sleep mode (HALT) awaiting hardware interrupt wakeup events. BSW Mode Manager (BswM) The BswM controls mode arbitration and executes configured action lists based on logical rule evaluations. function BswM_RequestMode [SWS_CP_SYS_00001] void BswM_RequestMode(BswM_UserType requesting_user, BswM_ModeType requested_mode); Service to request a BSW or application mode. Evaluates arbitration rules and triggers corresponding action lists. function BswM_Init [SWS_CP_SYS_00010] void BswM_Init(const BswM_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes the mode arbitration tables, state rules, and action list dispatchers. function BswM_MainFunction [SWS_CP_SYS_00011] void BswM_MainFunction(void); Periodic scheduled task for deferred mode rule evaluation and cyclic state processing. Watchdog Manager (WdgM) The WdgM supervises the correct execution of safety-critical software entities via Alive, Deadline, and Logical supervision mechanisms. function WdgM_Init [SWS_CP_SYS_00020] void WdgM_Init(const WdgM_ConfigType* ConfigPtr); Initializes the Watchdog Manager and configures supervision parameters for all registered supervised entities. function WdgM_CheckpointReached [SWS_CP_SYS_00021] Std_ReturnType WdgM_CheckpointReached(WdgM_SupervisedEntityIdType SEID, WdgM_CheckpointIdType CPID); Notifies the WdgM that a supervised execution checkpoint has been reached, updating Alive counters, Deadline timers, and Logical execution graph transitions. function WdgM_SetMode [SWS_CP_SYS_00022] Std_ReturnType WdgM_SetMode(WdgM_ModeType Mode); Switches watchdog supervision modes (e.g. SLOW_SUPERVISION, FAST_SUPERVISION, STOPPED_SUPERVISION) depending on vehicle operating states. function WdgM_MainFunction [SWS_CP_SYS_00023] void WdgM_MainFunction(void); Cyclically calculates global supervision status and triggers the Watchdog Interface (WdgIf) / Watchdog Driver if conditions are satisfied.
